author: Cleo Abram
description:
Guess how big Antarctica really is… 

And how thick the ice is…

Around 91% of the world's total fresh water is frozen here and if it melted, it would raise global sea levels by nearly 60 meters, lots of populated cities around the world would be underwater

But there’s something hidden deep under the ice… to see what, subscribe!

title: Antarctica Is Bigger Than You Think
